Python 1.2 typed differential comparisons committed but exact-head CI has not been executed green; zero independent certifications.
native_language_semantic_policy: R S3 source-scientific data records and native FPCA represent Python frozen dataclass/SciPy scientific arrays, not Python class or statsmodels object identity. RNG comparison claims only explicit PCG64 seeds, not unseeded entropy realizations.

case_evidence.description: Gaussian centered functional FPCR wild bootstrap residual-truncation k, pseudo-truth g=k, inference-truncation h>=k; source-typed source-mode signature with fixed target configuration, independent curve unit identification, NumPy PCG64 seed, normal or Mammen wild law.

Complete 24-curve observed-grid data with 13 times, single functional dimension, finite Gaussian numeric outcome, B=20, k=2 and h=3, two explicit Python NumPy RNG seeds 7 and 89, normal/Mammen multipliers; native-only fixed multiplier and base-R stream are rejected in source mode.

Fixed full-sample FPCA score basis, k-pseudo-truth, h-inference projection, studentized Gaussian FPCR roots, heteroscedastic sandwich score covariance with pseudo-fit residuals, NumPy higher empirical |root| quantiles, symmetric targetwise lower and upper intervals; source-typed Python differential arrays for all these numerical fields.

Reject nonfinite training/target trajectories, absent independent unit column, repeated independent unit IDs, h<k, source-invalid multiplier, insufficient wild replicates, invalid confidence level, rank deficient score covariance and nonzero bootstrap projection root with zero studentizing SE; strict mode rejects native-only multiplier/replay engine.

Twenty-one ordered FPCAWildBootstrapProjectionResult scientific fields, all result quantities as native R scientific arrays, full source ordered nested provenance including Gaussian independence and explicit multiplier support/moments; no extra R audit flags in source mode.

Centered fixed-target scalar-on-function projection under fixed FPCA functional regressors, independent row Gaussian model, heteroscedastic studentized wild bootstrap. Not clustered, not a future noisy-response interval, not familywise simultaneous and no component selection inside bootstrap.
